brief.sujet: Bank reconciliation discrepancies awaiting examination. Two low parallel green and graphite trays contain rows of blank cream paper cards. Small matte green clips visually match some pairs across the two trays. One cream card is deliberately placed apart on a small graphite exception tray, without stamp or checkmark. A blank file behind that tray holds prepared findings. Treat this as a geometric tactile miniature, not actual bank documents. Pending exception stays separate from matching pairs.
